about.titleHighlight: Land Rover Range Rover TDV8 ENGINE
paragraphs: The Range Rover TDV8 has been a mainstay of the Range Rover diesel range since the L322 generation, fitted across two generations from 2001 to 2021. Both the L322 (2001–2012) and L405 (2012–2021) generations use the same 4.4-litre V8 diesel architecture — the TDV8 and SDV8 are sibling engine families sharing the same known wear pattern around timing chain and injector components. The Range Rover TDV8 is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road. Land Rover Range Rover TDV8 Engine Codes TDV8 / SDV8 (L322, L405) A 4.4-litre V8 diesel fitted to the Range Rover across two generations. Known for timing chain and injector wear over time — see the callout above. We replace timing chain components, injector seals, and gaskets as standard on every TDV8 and SDV8 rebuild. Check Your TDV8 Range Rover → [link to quote form] Land Rover Range Rover TDV8 Engine Compatibility Because the TDV8 and SDV8 share the same engine architecture, compatibility comes down to ensuring the right generation (L322 or L405) and the correct variant badge for your vehicle. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm: Your exact engine code (TDV8 or SDV8) via registration or VIN Your generation (L322 or L405) Drivetrain and ancillary specification Any electronics or ECU considerations specific to your exact build This is why we always start with your registration rather than a generic TDV8 quote — it protects you from paying for parts that don't fit your actual car. The Range Rover TDV8 uses the 4.4-litre V8 diesel across two generations — the L322 (2001–2012) and L405 (2012–2021). The TDV8 and SDV8 are sibling engine families sharing the same 4.4-litre V8 architecture. How much does a Land Rover Range Rover TDV8 engine rebuild cost? Rebuilds start from £4,500. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote. Which engine code is fitted to my Range Rover TDV8? Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm whether you have the TDV8 or SDV8 before you're quoted anything. Do you rebuild TDV8 Range Rover engines? Yes. We replace worn timing chain components, injector seals, turbo components, EGR system and gaskets as standard on every TDV8 rebuild. Do you rebuild SDV8 Range Rover engines? Yes. The SDV8 shares the same engine architecture and known wear pattern as the TDV8, and we service it to the same standard. Do you supply used Range Rover TDV8 engines? Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation. Can you recover my Range Rover if the engine has failed? Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking. How long does a Range Rover TDV8 engine rebuild take? Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop. Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine? For most Range Rover owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers. cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the Range Rover TDV8 from 2023 to present. The TDV8 / SDV8 features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older TDV8 / SDV8 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every TDV8 / SDV8 rebuild.
